# Answers for Agents — Quick Answers Full Catalog

This catalog contains the self-contained Quick Answer snippets for all agent references on openclaw.xyz.

## How do you connect Claude to Gmail via MCP?
Category: MCP & Connectors | Slug: connect-claude-to-gmail-mcp

> To connect Claude to Gmail via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), add the official Google Gmail MCP server configuration to your Claude Desktop configuration file. Authenticate by creating a client credential via the Google Cloud Console and running the initial OAuth consent flow.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/mcp-connectors/connect-claude-to-gmail-mcp.html

---

## What is the MCP server URL format for Claude connectors?
Category: MCP & Connectors | Slug: mcp-server-url-format

> The Model Context Protocol (MCP) uses Server-Sent Events (SSE) for HTTP transport, where the client establishes a SSE connection to a GET endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:3000/sse) and sends JSON-RPC client-to-server messages via POST requests to a separate endpoint declared by the server.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/mcp-connectors/mcp-server-url-format.html

---

## How do you authenticate MCP connectors in Claude.ai?
Category: MCP & Connectors | Slug: mcp-auth-patterns

> In local environments, MCP servers authenticate via environment variables passed directly in the server config file. For remote, network-based MCP servers using Server-Sent Events (SSE), authentication is handled via Bearer tokens in the HTTP Authorization headers or customized query parameters.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/mcp-connectors/mcp-auth-patterns.html

---

## What MCP servers does Claude.ai support natively?

> Claude.ai (web interface) supports a selected set of official remote connectors natively, including Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, GitHub, and Slack, which authenticate directly via OAuth in the user profile settings, bypassing the need for local desktop configurations.

## Can you use multiple MCP servers in one Claude session?
Category: MCP & Connectors | Slug: multiple-mcp-servers-single-session

> Yes, Claude can connect to and query multiple MCP servers concurrently in a single chat session. The client merges all tools, prompts, and resources from all configured servers and presents them to Claude's model context.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/mcp-connectors/multiple-mcp-servers-single-session.html

## What transport protocols are supported by MCP?
Category: MCP & Connectors | Slug: mcp-transport-protocols-compared

> MCP supports two standard transport protocols: stdio (Standard Input/Output) for local sub-processes, and Server-Sent Events (SSE) for remote clients and web-based server setups using HTTP endpoints.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/mcp-connectors/mcp-transport-protocols-compared.html

---

## How do you configure Server-Sent Events (SSE) transport for MCP?
Category: MCP & Connectors | Slug: mcp-sse-transport-setup

> To configure SSE transport on an MCP server, instantiate an SSEServerTransport on your HTTP server routing layer to dispatch events, and implement a POST endpoint that accepts the client JSON-RPC payloads.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/mcp-connectors/mcp-sse-transport-setup.html

---

## How do you configure standard input/output (stdio) transport for MCP?
Category: MCP & Connectors | Slug: mcp-stdio-transport-setup

> To run an MCP server on stdio transport, connect it using StdioServerTransport from the SDK. The host process will spawn the server as a background process and communicate by reading and writing to its stdin/stdout streams.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/mcp-connectors/mcp-stdio-transport-setup.html

---

## How do you handle timeout errors in MCP server calls?
Category: MCP & Connectors | Slug: handle-mcp-timeout-errors

## How do you view and debug logs for MCP servers?

## What are the Claude API rate limits by tier?
Category: Claude API | Slug: claude-api-rate-limits-by-tier

> Claude API rate limits are governed by Tier structures based on your deposit history. Tier 1 has limits of 20,000 Tokens Per Minute (TPM) and 50 Requests Per Minute (RPM), scaling up to Tier 5 which provides up to 2,500,000 TPM and 4,000 RPM.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/claude-api/claude-api-rate-limits-by-tier.html

## What does a 529 overloaded error mean and how do you handle it?
Category: Claude API | Slug: handle-529-overloaded-error

> An HTTP 529 error indicates that Anthropic's servers are overloaded and unable to handle the request. Handle this error by implementing retry loops using exponential backoff with random jitter.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/claude-api/handle-529-overloaded-error.html

---

## How do you stream a Claude API response?
Category: Claude API | Slug: stream-claude-api-responses

> To stream Claude API responses, set the request parameter 'stream' to true. The server will emit Server-Sent Events containing JSON-RPC event chunks for message start, content delta updates, and completion.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/claude-api/stream-claude-api-responses.html

## What is the maximum context window for each Claude model?
Category: Claude API | Slug: maximum-context-window-by-model

> All current Claude 3 and Claude 3.5 models support a maximum context window of 200,000 tokens (approximately 150,000 words or 500 pages of text) per single API request.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/claude-api/maximum-context-window-by-model.html

## How do you pass a system prompt in the Claude API?
Category: Claude API | Slug: pass-system-prompt-claude-api

> Pass a system prompt by declaring the top-level 'system' string parameter in your API body request payload. Do not mix system instructions into the 'messages' array role declarations.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/claude-api/pass-system-prompt-claude-api.html

---

## What is the difference between input tokens and output tokens for billing?
Category: Claude API | Slug: input-vs-output-tokens-billing

> Input tokens represent all prompt text, system instructions, and tool definitions sent to Claude, billed at a lower rate (e.g., $3/M tokens for Sonnet). Output tokens represent the generated completion text, billed at a higher rate (e.g., $15/M tokens for Sonnet).

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/claude-api/input-vs-output-tokens-billing.html

---

## How do you set up API key authentication vs. OAuth in Claude?
Category: Claude API | Slug: api-key-vs-oauth-authentication

> API keys are best for back-end applications using secret environment keys. OAuth 2.0 is required for client-facing integrations on the Anthropic Console, allowing individual users to sign in and run requests on their own accounts.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/claude-api/api-key-vs-oauth-authentication.html

---

## How do you implement prompt caching in the Claude API?
Category: Claude API | Slug: claude-api-response-caching-setup

> Implement prompt caching by attaching the cache_control metadata block '{"type": "ephemeral"}' to blocks in your prompt (system prompts, tools, or messages) that are longer than 1024 tokens.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/claude-api/claude-api-response-caching-setup.html

---

## How do you force Claude to return valid JSON in API responses?
Category: Claude API | Slug: claude-api-json-mode-setup

> To force JSON output, declare your required JSON schema in a tool definition and set the tool_choice block to force a call to that tool, forcing Claude to structure the response as valid JSON arguments.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/claude-api/claude-api-json-mode-setup.html

## What is the maximum output token limit for Claude models?
Category: Claude API | Slug: claude-api-max-tokens-output

> Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Claude 3.5 Haiku support a maximum completion output of 8,192 tokens per single API request. Claude 3 Opus yields up to 4,096 output tokens.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/claude-api/claude-api-max-tokens-output.html

## How does the temperature parameter affect Claude's API responses?
Category: Claude API | Slug: claude-api-temperature-parameter

> The temperature parameter ranges from 0.0 to 1.0. Lower settings (e.g. 0.0) yield deterministic, highly factual answers, while values closer to 1.0 result in diverse, creative generation.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/claude-api/claude-api-temperature-parameter.html

---

## What are the top_p and top_k parameters in the Claude API?
Category: Claude API | Slug: claude-api-top-p-top-k

> top_k limits selection to the K highest probability next tokens, while top_p (nucleus sampling) selects from the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds P.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/claude-api/claude-api-top-p-top-k.html

---

> Structure your system prompts using XML tags (e.g., &lt;instructions&gt;, &lt;context&gt;, &lt;rules&gt;) to separate guidelines and instruction blocks, which matches Claude's pre-training.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/claude-api/claude-api-system-prompt-best-practices.html

## What is the correct JSON schema format for Claude tool definitions?
Category: Tool Use & Function Calling | Slug: json-schema-format-claude-tool-definitions

## How do you handle parallel tool calls in Claude?
Category: Tool Use & Function Calling | Slug: handle-parallel-tool-calls-claude

> When Claude decides to call multiple tools in a single turn, the API returns a message block containing multiple content blocks of type 'tool_use'. Iterate through the list, execute them in parallel, and return corresponding tool result blocks.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/tool-use/handle-parallel-tool-calls-claude.html

---

## How do you return a tool result to Claude?
Category: Tool Use & Function Calling | Slug: return-tool-result-to-claude

> Return tool results in a user message block containing a list of content blocks of type 'tool_result'. Each block must specify the matching 'tool_use_id' to bind the result to the initial request.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/tool-use/return-tool-result-to-claude.html

---

## Can Claude call the same tool multiple times in one turn?
Category: Tool Use & Function Calling | Slug: multiple-calls-same-tool-single-turn

> Yes. If Claude needs to fetch multiple independent data points, it will return multiple tool_use blocks referencing the same tool name but with distinct arguments and unique tool_use_ids.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/tool-use/multiple-calls-same-tool-single-turn.html

Category: Tool Use & Function Calling | Slug: force-claude-to-use-specific-tool

## What is tool_choice and how do you use it?
Category: Tool Use & Function Calling | Slug: use-tool-choice-parameter

> tool_choice governs how Claude selects tools. Use 'auto' to let Claude decide whether to use tools, 'any' to force Claude to select at least one tool, or type 'tool' with a name to force a specific tool.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/tool-use/use-tool-choice-parameter.html

---

## How do you handle tool call errors gracefully?
Category: Tool Use & Function Calling | Slug: handle-tool-call-errors-gracefully

> To report a tool execution failure to Claude, return a user message block with the parameter 'is_error' set to true. This tells Claude the tool failed, prompting the model to fix its input arguments.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/tool-use/handle-tool-call-errors-gracefully.html

## How do tool definitions affect input token billing?
Category: Tool Use & Function Calling | Slug: claude-tool-use-tokens-cost

## How do you handle streaming responses when tools are called?
Category: Tool Use & Function Calling | Slug: claude-streaming-with-tool-calls

> In stream responses, listen for events of type 'content_block_start' with content type 'tool_use'. Collect arguments from 'content_block_delta' events, and execute the tool once the block completes.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/tool-use/claude-streaming-with-tool-calls.html

## How do you build a ReAct agent loop manually with Claude?
Category: Agent Frameworks | Slug: implement-recommender-agent-claude

> Build a manual ReAct loop by creating a while-loop that passes tools, reads Claude's tool_use calls, executes the matching code locally, and posts the results back until Claude returns a text completion.

## How do you prevent prompt injection in tool-use agents?
Category: Agentic Security & Safety | Slug: prevent-prompt-injection-tool-use

> Prevent prompt injection in tool-use agents by validating and sanitizing all untrusted user and tool outputs, enforcing strict schema validation, isolating tool execution from core agent instructions, and using system prompt instructions that warn the model to treat tool data strictly as untrusted content.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/agentic-security/prevent-prompt-injection-tool-use.html

## How do you safely sandbox code execution tools for AI agents?
Category: Agentic Security & Safety | Slug: sandbox-code-execution-agents

> Sandbox code execution tools by running all interpreter processes inside isolated containers (like Docker or gVisor), restricting network access, setting CPU/memory resource limits, enforcing a read-only root filesystem where possible, and using short process timeout thresholds.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/agentic-security/sandbox-code-execution-agents.html

## How do you securely store credentials for custom MCP servers?
Category: Agentic Security & Safety | Slug: secure-mcp-credentials-storage

> Store credentials for custom MCP servers in system environment variables or secure credential managers (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, Vault, or local Keychain) and retrieve them dynamically at runtime instead of hardcoding tokens inside the Claude Desktop config.json file.

## What are the best practices for implementing human-in-the-loop (HITL) gatekeeping for agentic writes?
Category: Agentic Security & Safety | Slug: human-in-the-loop-agentic-writes

> Implement human-in-the-loop gatekeeping for agentic writes by defining a whitelist of read-only tools and requiring explicit user authorization (via CLI prompts, Slack approval buttons, or web dashboards) before executing state-modifying actions like write files, run terminal commands, or make payments.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/agentic-security/human-in-the-loop-agentic-writes.html

## How do you protect agentic scrapers from honey pots and recursive scraping loops?
Category: Agentic Security & Safety | Slug: protect-agentic-scrapers-infinite-loops

> Protect agentic scrapers from recursive loops and honeypots by enforcing strict URL domain whitelists, setting max crawling depth limits (e.g., 3 levels), tracking and deduplicating visited URLs using a hash set, and capping total execution execution time per run.

Full URL: https://outclaw.xyz/answers/agentic-security/protect-agentic-scrapers-infinite-loops.html
